_comment: Configuration for dev-contribution-quality-analysis scripts. Copy and customise. Paths are resolved relative to the config file location.
_input_hint: CSVs must match the format produced by the project-scoped counterpart skill extraction scripts (extract-commits.sh, extract-mr-acceptances.sh).
_identity_hint: The shared identity alias matrix from the project-scoped counterpart skill is loaded first when present. Use email_to_person below only for run-specific overrides.
_repo_roots_hint: Optional repo roots for Tier 2 analysis (complexity delta, test path detection, CC-* sampling). When omitted, analysis uses CSV-only Tier 1 signals.
_target_hint: When empty, all persons in the CSV are analyzed. Specify names (canonical, after alias resolution) to limit scope.

email_to_person._comment: Config-local identity overrides layered on top of shared alias matrix.

person_timezone._comment: UTC offset (hours) per person for local-time analysis.

role_calibration._comment: Role-based expectation adjustments. Keys are canonical person names.

_window_hint: Recommended minimum: 60 days. Below 60 days, some signals become noisy.

scoring._d6_hint: D6 is context-only and does not affect tier assignment regardless of weight.

quality_sampling._comment: Code quality sampling configuration. Requires repo_roots to be set.

thresholds._comment: Scoring thresholds. See references/scoring-model.md for full definitions.

report_options._trend_hint: Trend analysis requires multiple analysis windows. Run the pipeline for each window and pass all profiles to generate-quality-report.py.
